references.text: The angel tells the women at the tomb that Jesus has gone ahead to Galilee, just as Jesus predicted in Matt 26:32.
Jesus himself confirms to the women that the disciples should go to Galilee to see him, in line with what he said in Matt 26:32.
The disciples go to Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had told them to go, fulfilling Jesus' words in Matt 26:32.

Jacob's blessing of his sons in Gen 49:7 can be seen as a precursor to Jesus' instructions to meet him in Galilee, a place with significant historical and spiritual importance for the people of Israel.
